_about: Meta message template the staff room sends when the director's 24-hour window is closed. Generated from the ERP's seed `staff_office_approval` (apps/web/src/lib/waTemplates.ts) with buildMetaTemplateCreatePayload — the ERP's template autopilot submits it to Meta on its own within an hour of deploy; this file is the exact payload for a manual submission (README §8).
_send: POST /api/wa/dispatch with template { name: 'bhb_office_approval', language: 'en', variableKeys: ['draftId','draftSummary'], variables: { draftId, draftSummary }, quickReplyPayloads: ['Approve <id>', 'Reject <id>'] } — a tap then arrives as the payload, which the poller reads like a typed reply.

body_text: To: Mrs. Sharma | Subject: Re: TC request | Dear Mrs. Sharma, the transfer certificate will be ready on Friday.
